description: This file defines a Presenter class for managing UI state and interactions in a surface flinger viewer, including handling trace data, filters, and UI updates.

classes.name: Presenter
classes.description: Manages UI state, trace data, filters, and interactions for the surface flinger viewer, including generating UI data and handling user actions.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates UI data based on the current trace position.

methods.name: updatePinnedItems
methods.description: Adds or removes a pinned item and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Highlights or unhighlights an item in the UI.

methods.name: updateHierarchyTree
methods.description: Updates hierarchy filter options and regenerates the tree.

methods.name: filterHierarchyTree
methods.description: Applies a filter to the hierarchy tree.

methods.name: updatePropertiesTree
methods.description: Updates property options and UI for selected properties.

methods.name: newPropertiesTree
methods.description: Sets a new selected hierarchy item and updates UI.

methods.name: generateRects
methods.description: Generates rectangle data for display based on trace entries.

methods.name: getLayersForRectsView
methods.description: Filters layers for rectangle view based on visibility options.

methods.name: compareLayerZ
methods.description: Compares layers based on Z-order for sorting.

methods.name: updateSelectedTreeUiData
methods.description: Updates UI data for the selected hierarchy tree.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Generates a hierarchy tree based on current filters and options.

methods.name: rectsToUiData
methods.description: Converts raw rect data into UI rectangle objects.

methods.name: updatePinnedIds
methods.description: Adds or removes IDs from the pinned list.

methods.name: getTreeWithTransformedProperties
methods.description: Transforms a hierarchy tree with property data.

methods.name: shouldDisplayPropertyGroups
methods.description: Determines if property groups should be shown for a layer.

methods.name: copyUiDataAndNotifyView
methods.description: Creates a copy of UI data and triggers view update.
